shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin holds near $74K despite 4th day of spot ETF outflows; Ethereum also sees slight decline.
Crypto Fear & Greed Index drops to 26 (Fear) from Neutral readings last week.
US October CPI rose 0.4% (above forecast), increasing expectations for a December Fed rate hike.
Bitcoin liquidity is weakening due to stablecoin supply contraction and persistent ETF outflows.
US midterms result in Democratic Congress, potentially increasing regulatory scrutiny on crypto.
